subject: Pricing workback: HIPAA + EU residency + HSM seat model
raw_messages:
From: Nadia Romero <nadia.romero@healthgrid.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Info needed: HIPAA + EU residency + HSM pricing

Marcus —

Quick note from my side. We are mapping pricing for a pilot + potential enterprise roll in Q1. High-level ask: can you share a workback that breaks out costs for the following line items so we can model both a 12‑month and 36‑month commitment?

- HIPAA support (compliance add-on) — annual fee or per-seat?
- EU data residency (separate regional surcharge / dedicated infra)
- HSM seats (one-time vs monthly) and a per‑request KMS fallback option
- Audit log retention tiers (30/90/365 days) and per‑GB pricing

Estimated first-year footprint: ~200k generated tokens/day, 3M embeddings/month, peak 60 qps. We may want 3 dedicated HSM seats for key signing operations.

Attaching a quick forecast to help (HealthGrid_Usage_Forecast.xlsx). Could you point to any package options or discounts for multi-year commitments? Also, we care about cost allocation between capex (HSM) vs opex (usage).

Thanks — Nadia
Nadia Romero
Head of Platform — HealthGrid
nadia.romero@healthgrid.ai
+44 7700 900111

---
Attachment: HealthGrid_Usage_Forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Nadia Romero <nadia.romero@healthgrid.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Info needed: HIPAA + EU residency + HSM pricing

Hi Nadia — thanks for the details and the forecast (helpful). I sketched a concise workback below — happy to do a short call to walk through assumptions.

Summary (high level):
- HIPAA add-on: one-time onboarding fee $25k + $1,200/month for monitoring & extra audit support.
- EU residency: regional node surcharge = $0.035 /k token served (approx) or flat reserved pool option ($6k / month reserved capacity).
- HSM seats: two pricing options
  • One-time purchase per seat: $45k / seat (includes HW lifecycle & onboarding)
  • Monthly managed HSM seat: $1,600 / seat / month (includes 24/7 support)
  • KMS per-request fallback: $0.00012 / request (good for occasional signing)
- Audit logs: 30d free; 90d = $0.02 /GB /month; 365d = $0.05 /GB /month; ingest and retention billed separately.

Discounting and packaging:
- Bundle: HIPAA + EU residency + HSM (12‑month commit) = 15% off list for the bundle.
- 36‑month commit on HSM seats (or 3‑year prepaid) — we can extend to 20% off HSM list pricing, subject to legal/finance approval.

Notes on capex vs opex: one-time HSM purchase shows as capex; monthly seats and regional surcharge as opex. We can create a blended model in the contract to allocate costs per your internal accounting.

I attached a simple workbook with the line items and a sample blended TCO for the first 3 years (HG_pricing_workback.xlsx). Can we set a 30‑minute call Wednesday to finalize assumptions?

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
(415) 555‑0192

From: Nadia Romero <nadia.romero@healthgrid.ai>

Cc: Tomas Eriksen <tomas.eriksen@healthgrid.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Info needed: HIPAA + EU residency + HSM pricing

Thanks Marcus — this is very helpful. A few follow ups so we can finalize our model before the call:

1) For the HSM seats — is the one‑time purchase tied to a maintenance agreement? If we bought seats outright, what are ongoing support / replacement costs year‑over‑year?
2) For EU residency, the reserved pool option sounds appealing — what are the min capacity commitments and how does peak bursting to other regions work?
3) On discounts — HealthGrid is willing to talk multi‑year but we need to understand the budget treatment. If we commit to 36 months for HSM seats, can you confirm that the 20% is stackable with the 12‑month bundle discount or only replaces it?

If you can confirm in an email we can share with finance and come prepared on the call. Appreciate you pulling this together.

— Nadia
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: HealthGrid pricing Qs — approval request and guidance

Team — forwarding HealthGrid Qs (below). Need quick guidance so I can give Nadia definitive answers:

- Maintenance on one-time HSM purchase: can we commit to standard 3‑year maintenance at 10% of unit price/yr (covers firmware updates, replacement within SLA)? Will legal require any special indemnity for on-prem HSM hardware?
- EU reserved pool: what is the minimum reserved capacity we should quote to avoid significant burst premiums? I suggested $6k/month as a placeholder — does that align with product ops numbers?
- Discount stacking: Sales asks for 20% off HSM seats for a 36‑month prepay and to additionally waive first‑year EU residency surcharge — finance/legal to confirm if stackable with 15% bundle discount or if we must present a single best offer.

Context: HealthGrid is a strategic prospect (pipeline: HG‑47). They are price‑sensitive but value strong SLAs and HSM isolation. If we can do the blended offer, this will likely accelerate a reserved capacity deal.

Can you reply with approvals / redlines by end of day Thursday? I want to propose final terms on Friday.

Thanks — Marcus

[quoted text]
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Nadia Romero <nadia.romero@healthgrid.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Final offer: HealthGrid HIPAA + EU residency + HSM (workback)

Hi Nadia — thanks for the patience while we finalized approvals. Below is the adjusted, final offer for HealthGrid (valid 30 days). I copied Monica (CS) and Priyom (Finance) to help with technical onboarding and billing terms.

Final commercial summary (annualized view unless noted):
- HIPAA add-on: one-time onboarding $25k (unchanged) + $1,050 / month for monitoring & audit support (reduced).
- EU residency: waived regional surcharge for first 12 months for reserved pool customers; reserved pool option: $5,500 / month (min 3 months reservation) thereafter. Bursting to other regions will be allowed up to 20% of reserved capacity at a small premium (0.01/k token).
- HSM seats:
  • One-time purchase: $45,000 / seat; standard maintenance 10% /yr (years 1–3) covers firmware updates & replacement SLA.
  • 36‑month prepaid option: 20% off the one‑time seat price (final seat price $36,000) — this is our best HSM seat concession.
  • Monthly managed seat alternative remains $1,600 / seat / month.
- Audit logs: 30d free; 90d = $0.018 /GB /month; 365d = $0.045 /GB /month.

Discounting and stacking:
- We can offer the 20% prepaid HSM concession in combination with the 15% bundle discount only if HealthGrid agrees to a 24‑month minimum for the bundle commitment (i.e., two year minimum for the reserved capacity + HIPAA). Alternatively, we can present a single best offer (20% HSM + waived first‑year residency) without the additional 15% bundle discount.

Next steps and artifacts:
- I attached an updated SOW (SOW_HealthGrid_v2.pdf) that reflects the 36‑month prepaid seat calculation and the waived residency surcharge for year 1.
- If that looks good, please sign via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/XYZ-HealthGrid-SOW.

Open items (we want to lock these before DocuSign):
- Confirmation from your finance team on capex vs opex treatment for the prepaid HSM seats.
- Agreement on min reserved pool months (we proposed 3 months above).

Happy to hop on a final 30‑minute call if you prefer. We can also circulate a redline of the SOW if legal wants changes.

Best,
Marcus Lin
